item.title: Update Shelf 0.9.9
item.description: Plug-in release checks for mapped Melda effects, RX 12, Ozone 12, BIAS X and TONE3000; reviewed vendor-manager handoffs; exact installed-file verification after vendor updates; custom scan folders and exclusions; per-module version and architecture diagnostics. Plug-in installation stays with the vendor. Unsupported products and unknown compatibility remain explicit.
